dialogues.speaker: Lilian
dialogues.text: I'm trying to grow flowers with different scents, so I can make a range of fragrances.

dialogues.speaker: Lilian
dialogues.text: Like this one, Miss Mary. You can craft a top note from it that's as fresh as a light rain. While Lady Gildan over there serves as a grounding, full-bodied middle note...

dialogues.speaker: Lilian
dialogues.text: But then... Hmm. What should the base note be?
